short_prompt: Draw a branched underground fortress in a cut mountain with six connected occupied levels. Preserve the calculated topology, true stair and door apertures, supports and distinct program assemblies. Apply the shared neutral graphite and fine-ink art direction, with restrained English arrows.
intent: Branching conceptual underground fortress, six connected levels and a physically empty mountain cavity. The selected branched graph is realized with its own walls, apertures, supported corridors and furnishing assemblies.

relationships: existing typed interfaces or localized attachments

negative_controls: Incorrect inventory; floating worker, displaced route endpoint, detached attachment or shaft/bearing misalignment where the actual fixture defines them.
limits: No final-pixel observation is supplied by these geometry commands.
Coverage partial remains partial; a schema number or successful loader cannot promote it to complete strict coverage.
No load, dynamics, hydraulic or biomechanical certification.
